title: Vessels S7: rewards, renown, contraband and customs
description:
Vessels study step S7 (`docs/ongoing-projects/vessels-ships.md`, Part 5 step 7; design in 3.3.7 and 3.3.9). The plan, interpretations, ablation, decisions made while building, and verification are in the "Phase 7 (S7) progress" section.

Review range: `vessels-s7-base..vessels-s7`.

## What changes for players

- **Renown.** A hull's renown is won by sinking another player's hull: the sunk hull's weight (a boat 25, a ship 200, a warship 285), split among the hull that sank her and her grouped allies in sight. The loser drops it, and her crew lose a further 1% of their experience per 30 renown lost. NPC kills train crews but move no renown. Renown survives the wreck registry and trade-ins. `shipcrew` shows it, and `shiprenown` lists the ten most renowned hulls.
- **Prize money.** Every sinking by a player's hull pays the same sharers salvage (an eighth of the sunk hull's value scaled by what is left of her, plus half the price of each surviving weapon), a bounty of 2.5 gold per renown point above 100 (raiders now carry 150-3,000 renown), and the whole WANTED or HUNTED bounty of an owner who went down aboard, which is then cleared. It is paid through the existing settlement queue with a mail receipt.
- **Renown gates.** Able hands need 540-700 renown and veteran hands 1,350-1,640. A capital weapon needs 1,600-2,000 renown, or a veteran gunner aboard as before. Raiders scale with the quarry's renown.
- **Ship Damage Control**, an epic feat of five ranks, cuts every blow to the hull and sails of a vessel its holder owns and is aboard by 4% plus 4% per rank.
- **Contraband.** Forbidden tomes, rare poisons, and dragon eggs are each sold at one sea port, to a hull of 150, 200, or 250 renown or one with an able sailmaster and quartermaster, never to a warship or a buyer at alignment 1,000. Other ports pay their scarce price. Lawful ports' customs search hulls sailing in and seize contraband they do not stock, at Duris's odds: more likely with more units, less with renown, and much less in a full hold.
- **Cargo sales.** A seller with the SEADOG feat gets +10%, a hull under neutral colors -10%, and a warship -40%.

## Code and data

- New `src/vessels/vessels_rewards.c` (renown, the sinking settlement, `shiprenown`) and `unittests/CuTest/test_vessel_rewards.c`. Contraband, customs, and the sale factor are in `vessels_trade.c`. The claim queue in `vessels_upgrades.c` is shared by insurance and prize money. The feat is `FEAT_SHIP_DAMAGE_CONTROL`.
- Phase 23 SQL (`ship_runtime_state.renown`, `trade_commodities.contraband_renown`), with rollback and verifier. Contraband content (`vessels_contraband_content.sql`: three goods stocked at Selerish Slateharbor, Southwest Quechian, and Koorvik), with rollback and verifier. The dev harbor fixture also stocks tomes at its East Dock for the gate.
- Help: new SHIPRENOWN entry, plus updates to SHIPHIRE, MARKET (CONTRABAND, CUSTOMS, SMUGGLING), PLUNDER, SHIPBROWSE, and SHIPFIRE. Updated in both `help.hlp` and `help_vessel_entries.sql`; the verifier checks 34 entries, 91 keywords, and 40 content items.
- New live gate: `scripts/vessels/test_vessel_economy_in_game.sh`.

## Verification

- `make test-all` with the database cases on: 1,963 CuTest cases (8 new rewards and economy tests, plus new raider, weapon, crew, and feat cases) and the protocol harness.
- Phase 23 applies alone to a fresh master schema, verifies, rolls back, and reapplies. The contraband content reapplies to the same rows, verifies, and rolls back.
- Vessel help verifier: 34 entries, 91 keywords, 40 content checks.
- All 19 live gates pass in the private namespace: the 18 existing gates (harbor merchant, campaign, Vailand merchant, builder, gunnery, tactical, lookout, boarding, narrative, rules, events, movement, loss, damage, derelict, hunter, frontier, raider) and the new economy gate.
  - In the economy gate, Vesselmate is refused forbidden tomes with no renown and buys them once an able crew signs on. One tome sells for a tenth less under neutral colors. With the dock's stock lifted, customs seize the tomes as the hull sails back in. Kohdee's warships sink Vesselmate's boat; the victor wins 25 renown and 40 gold of prize money.
  - On the final build the loss and economy gates pass again.
- Local CI (`scripts/ci/local/run.py --base gitlab/master`): all 33 jobs pass on `c404b1690`. That is the final code commit; only documentation follows it.
- Found and fixed along the way:
  - The economy gate found that hulls berthed in port shared a sinking's rewards; Duris passes docked ships over, and so does the settlement now (`9bc23e5a1`).
  - `make test-all`'s SQL interpolation check required a prepared statement for the stock lookup (`a2e8bb218`).
  - The CI matrix found `master_schema.sql` missing the new column, plus two clang-tidy findings (`c404b1690`).

After merge: sync the S7 vessel help to production. Production needs `vessels_phase23_schema.sql` and `vessels_contraband_content.sql` applied before contraband is sold anywhere; boot adds the two columns itself.

## Review round 1

Three P2 findings, all fixed on top of `vessels-s7`, one commit each (range `vessels-s7..feat/vessels-s7`):

- `9c8876360`: a sinking's settlement is one transaction covering the bounty's collection, each sharer's renown and prize claim, and the sunk hull's renown with her last attacker consumed. A hull restored mid-sinking pays nothing twice, and if the transaction fails nothing is paid.
- `d2a1c4a22`: customs confiscate only where the port is known not to stock the contraband. A failed stock lookup lets the lot pass.
- `e1ffd9005`: unstocked contraband pays its scarce price for every unit, however the hold is split.

Verification on `e1ffd9005`:

- `make test-all` with the database cases on: 1,963 CuTest cases and the protocol harness. The sinking tests now run against the test database, and the new settlement and sale cases fail on `vessels-s7`'s code.
- The clang-tidy gate respects its baseline.
- After a fresh reload of the development dump, the loss gate (82 s) and the economy gate (249 s) pass.
- Local CI (`scripts/ci/local/run.py --base gitlab/master`): all 33 jobs pass (632 s).
- The record commit `a2b326d92` changes only documentation; format-check and hygiene pass on it.
